models_evaluated: AI chest radiograph model for abnormal bone mineral density screening

links.outcome: AI performance across BMI and sex subgroups versus aggregate performance
links.effect: Population-level AUC 0.95 and sensitivity 79.7%; intersectional subgroup analyses were exploratory because of small event counts. Decision curve net benefit was highest for women with normal BMI.
links.quote: Although BMI distributions paralleled East Asian regional trends, intersectional subgroup analyses remain exploratory due to small event counts.

unlisted_practices: Decision curve analysis to compare net benefit of AI-based referral against refer-all and refer-none strategies

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic performance and equity/decision curve analysis of an AI model for opportunistic screening of abnormal BMD on chest radiographs in an Asian health examination cohort.
